TRMM’s PR provides the opportunity to intercompare the radar observations collected during individual field campaigns, in the context of the climatological distribution of the rainfall systems present in the region of interest.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the TRMM climatology of rainfall morphology and rainfall intensity is consistent with the ground-based observations of the same characteristics, but with a few notable exceptions that are discussed in detail in this presentation.

the PR’s snapshot of the radar field in a given area is useful for examining the statistical distribution of the rainfall and convective characteristics of the storms in a given area on a monthly timescale.

, when compared with the TRMM climatology, the field campaign observations are representative of the climatology in the region of the campaign in terms of the rainfall and convective characteristics, and that, when compared to each other, field campaigns in a region can be considered to have observed similar rainfall regimes.
